title: Management
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: Supportive management such as hydration, adequate feeding and avoidance of concomitant use of hepatotoxic medications including herbals is all that is required in mild infections. The disease resolves spontaneously in several weeks or months.

runs.text: Supportive management such as hydration, adequate feeding and avoidance of concomitant use of hepatotoxic medications

blocks.text: Hospitalization is necessary in settings of acute liver failure. Therapy is aimed at maintaining fluid replacement, balanced nutritional feeding, relief of pains and fever including specific management for liver failure.
